name: Mini Remote Control
description: A small rechargeable, battery-powered wireless remote that controls Insteon devices or groups of devices. Insteon sells it in 4-scene, 8-scene, and 1-scene switch versions, and it can be wall-mounted without wiring.

steps.text: Fully charge the Mini Remote with a Type A to Micro-B USB cable before programming; the red charging LED turns off when the battery is fully charged.
Slide the power switch to the on position (right).

notes: The Mini Remote needs an Insteon dual-band or RF device nearby to talk to the rest of the Insteon network.
The Mini Remote beeps quietly during setup, so program it in a quiet area.

steps.text: Tap the scene button you want to use; on a four-scene remote the on or off button both work, and on the switch tap the top or bottom of the paddle.
Press and hold the SET button until the Mini Remote beeps.

notes: To make a Mini Remote button a scene controller: put the Mini Remote in linking mode, adjust the responder to the state you want, then press and hold the responder's SET button until it beeps or its LED flashes. The Mini Remote double-beeps and its LED stops blinking.
Test the link by tapping the button on and off; the responder toggles between the scene on-level and off.

verification.note: The Mini Remote Control 2342 Owner's Manual says setup mode times out after more than 3 minutes with a long beep; the RemoteLinc 2 Developer Notes say the LED blinks green for 4 minutes or until linked. The catalog uses the owner's manual's 3 minutes (180 seconds).

steps.text: Tap the scene button you want to use; on a four-scene remote the on or off button both work, and on the switch tap the top or bottom of the paddle.
Press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds, until it beeps.
Tap the SET button.
Have the Hub start ALL-Linking as the responder.
steps.expect: The Hub reports ALL-Linking Completed with the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: Have the Hub send Ping a few times to check the link.
When all responders are added, tap the SET button.

notes: The device must already be in linking mode when the Hub starts ALL-Linking, since the Hub waits only about 10 seconds. This links the device's group 1 to the Hub; the Hub makes no link to the device.

verification.note: No document describes this; it's how the device is set up in practice.

steps.text: Tap the scene button you want to use; on a four-scene remote the on or off button both work, and on the switch tap the top or bottom of the paddle.
Press and hold the SET button for 3 seconds, until it beeps.
Tap the SET button.
For each responder, adjust it to the state you want, then press and hold its SET button until the Mini Remote double-beeps.
steps.expect: Double beep; LED keeps double-blinking green

steps.text: When all responders are added, tap the SET button.
Tap the scene button you want to use; on a four-scene remote the on or off button both work, and on the switch tap the top or bottom of the paddle.
Press and hold the SET button until the Mini Remote beeps.
Press and hold the SET button again until it beeps.
Press and hold the responder's SET button until it double-beeps or its LED blinks.
steps.expect: Mini Remote double-beeps and its LED stops blinking

notes: Remove responders you no longer use; otherwise the Mini Remote retries every scene command, which causes delays and shortens battery life.

To unlink several responders in one session, tap the SET button after the LED starts blinking red (it double-blinks red), press and hold each responder's SET button until the Mini Remote double-beeps, then tap the SET button to finish.

steps.text: If possible, unlink all scene responders first.
Turn the Mini Remote off by sliding the power switch to the left.
Press and hold the SET button.
While still holding the SET button, turn the Mini Remote back on by sliding the power switch to the right.
steps.expect: Beep, LED stays solid green, then a long beep

steps.text: Keep holding the SET button until the long beep stops.
Release the SET button.
Remove the device from every scene, as a controller and as a responder.

verification.note: No document describes this; it's how the device is set up in practice.

steps.text: Remove the device from every scene on the Hub first.
Tap the scene button you want to use; on a four-scene remote the on or off button both work, and on the switch tap the top or bottom of the paddle.
Press and hold the SET button until the Mini Remote beeps.
Press and hold the SET button again until it beeps.
Have the Hub start ALL-Linking for group 0, so it answers as the responder; the device deletes its link to the Hub.
steps.expect: The Hub reports the device's Insteon ID

steps.text: If the LED is still blinking, tap the SET button until it stops.

notes: The Hub won't remove a device that still belongs to a scene.

verification.note: No document describes this; it's how the device is set up in practice.

notes: Comes as a 4-scene remote, an 8-scene remote, and a single on/off switch.
Runs on a rechargeable battery and doesn't repeat messages.
sources: Mini Remote Control 2342 Quick Start Guide
